hints.title: Value Transition
hints.text: A good subsequence can be extended by a new value x if and only if the last element was either x - 1 or x + 1, or x can start a new sequence on its own.

hints.title: Dual State Maintenance
hints.text: Maintain two lookup tables: count[v] storing the number of valid sequences ending with v, and sum[v] storing the sum of all elements in those sequences.

hints.title: Modulo Accumulation
hints.text: When appending x, new sequences formed equal 1 + count[x - 1] + count[x + 1], and their total sum equals x * new_count + sum[x - 1] + sum[x + 1].

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Maintains frequency and cumulative sum arrays indexed by number value in linear time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Enumerating all 2^n subsequences causes TLE and memory overflow.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(M) space where M is the maximum element in nums.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Maintains dual count and sum accumulators per value under modulo 10^9+7.
